chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Qasim ibn Yahya, from his grandfather al-Hasan ibn Rashid, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: 'Wear the cotton garments, for they are the attire of the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family), and it is our attire.'

key_terms.ثِيَابَ الْقُطْنِ: Cotton garments — preferred dress in Islamic tradition due to their association with the Prophet
key_terms.لِبَاسُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: The attire of the Messenger of God — appeals to prophetic practice as normative authority
key_terms.لِبَاسُنَا: Our attire — the Imams' self-identification with the prophetic practice

ai.seo_question: Did Imam Ali recommend wearing cotton clothes? What does al-Kafi say about cotton garments?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) transmits a saying of Imam Ali (AS) commanding the wearing of cotton garments. The directive is grounded in prophetic precedent — cotton was the preferred clothing of the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) — and is thus also the practice of the Imams from Ahl al-Bayt. This hadith reflects the tradition of following prophetic dress customs as an act of emulation (iqtida') and belongs to the broader jurisprudential discussions on recommended attire in al-Kafi's chapter on clothing.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Qasim Bin Yahya, from his grandfather Al Hassan Bin Rashid, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Wear the cotton clothes, for these are the clothes of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, and these are our<sup>asws</sup> clothes’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Qasim ibn Yahya from his grandfather al-Hassan ibn Rashid f, abu Basir who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that ’Amir al-Mu’minin has said, ‘You must wear cotton clothes because it is the clothes of the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, and our clothes.”’
